description: The keyword null followed by an argument list is a call to a function named null
notes: The spec says that where an identifier acts as a keyword, that role supersedes any other interpretation, and null is a keyword among expression terms, so the parentheses after null would be a syntax error. hashicorp/hcl checks for an opening parenthesis after any identifier before it recognizes the keywords true, false and null, so this is a call to a function named null (parseExpressionTerm in hclsyntax/parser.go).
